title: Homeowner Contract Terms: Change Orders on Replacement System Installations
content:
# Change orders — Replacement System Installations

## Retired clause

The following clause is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis for billing work beyond the package scope:

> Work beyond the package scope is billed only through a numbered change order: a new line set at the package's line-set change-order price where the package does not include one, duct modification beyond the allowance at the package's per-foot duct modification price, and other scope at the price written on the change order.

## Clauses in force

**Homeowner approval.** A change order is billed only after the homeowner has confirmed a change-order approval request for that change order number. Approving a change order is the homeowner's own decision: the agent records the request and the homeowner confirms it.

**Numbering.** Change orders are numbered from 1 in the order approved.

**Ceiling.** The total of the change orders on a project may not exceed the package's change-order ceiling percentage of the contract price; work beyond that limit requires a new contract. The ceiling in dollars is the contract price multiplied by the ceiling percentage and divided by 100; the room remaining is that ceiling less the total of the change-order charges already on the project over its life to the date of handling.

**Timing.** A change order cannot be added once the project is installed.

**Declined change orders.** A change order the homeowner declines is never billed.

## Condition — judgement — result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A change-order approval request for that number is confirmed by the homeowner | Approval on record | The change order may be billed |
| The homeowner declined that change order | No approval | Never billed |
| The project is installed | Too late | No change order can be added |
| The change orders would total more than the ceiling | Over the limit | The work requires a new contract |

## Worked example (hypothetical project)

A hypothetical contract price of $11295.00 with a 20 percent ceiling gives a ceiling of $2259.00. With a single change-order charge of $895.00 already on the project, the room remaining is $1364.00, and the next change order approved on that project carries number 2.
